description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of member of the Dehiowita Pradheshiya Sabha
reasoning: The gazette content is specifically about filling a vacancy in a local government body (Dehiowita Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's absence, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This falls squarely under electoral processes and the administration of local authority elections, making it an **Elections Gazette (Type 7)**.
